newsitem.title: USA: Crazy Eddie creditors to get $8.87 mln payment.
newsitem.headline: Crazy Eddie creditors to get $8.87 mln payment.

text.p: Lawyers representing the bankrupt consumer electronics firm Crazy Eddie Inc, said Monday it has received $8.87 million from the company's founder Edie Antar, currently serving time in federal prison for violations of securities law.

The firm of Cadwalader, Wickersham & Taft said that this payment is the first phase of a court-ordered distribution of $76.5 million to be paid to defrauded bondholders, shareholders, vendors, creditors and the company.

The money represents cash skimmed from Crazy Eddie the early 1980s and hidden by Antar in secret bank accounts in Israel and Switzerland, said Cadwalader and is a portion of $80 million in assets already recovered from Antar through Securities and Exchange Commission actions.
